# HackIEEE 2026-27 | National-Level 36-Hour Offline Hackathon

> HackIEEE is India's premier national-level hackathon hosted by the IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter at Nirma University, Ahmedabad, in collaboration with Kiro. A high-intensity 36-hour offline hackathon inviting top engineering talent and student innovators from across the country to build, stage, and ship considered code.

- **Event:** HackIEEE 2026-27 (Inaugural Edition)
- **Scope & Scale:** All-India National-Level Hackathon
- **Format:** 36-Hour Continuous In-Person / Offline Hackathon
- **Venue:** Nirma University Campus, Sarkhej - Gandhinagar Highway, Gota, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382481, India
- **Geographic Coordinates:** 23.1287° N, 72.5447° E
- **Team Size:** 1 to 4 members per team (inter-college teams permitted)
- **Eligibility:** Undergraduate, postgraduate students, and early developers nationwide and globally
- **Cost:** 100% Free registration (no entry fee)
- **Accommodations:** Meals, high-speed connectivity, overnight hacking facilities, and direct industry mentorship provided to shortlisted finalists at the Nirma campus
- **Official Website:** https://hack.ieeenirma.org
- **Contact Email:** deep@computer.org
- **Contact Phone:** +91 92656 41668
- **Organizers:** IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter at Nirma University (with IEEE ITSS & IEEE SPS)
- **Industry Collaborator:** Kiro (https://kiro.dev)

## Hackathon Timeline & Phases

1. **Phase 0 — National Registrations Open (November 15, 2026):**
   Global and national registration opens. Teams submit ideas and form squads of up to 4 members.
2. **Phase 1 — Track Declaration & Team Shortlisting (December 20, 2026):**
   Official problem statements and competitive challenge tracks unveiled. Top teams shortlisted for the offline finale.
3. **Phase 2 — The 36-Hour Offline Grand Finale (January 2–4, 2027):**
   Three days of nonstop building, real-time code reviews, mentor check-ins, jury evaluations, and the grand awards ceremony at Nirma University.

## Core Pillars & Values

- **Build & Ship:** Transform real-world problem statements into working prototypes and production-grade architectures within 48 hours.
- **Connect & Network:** Collaborate with fellow innovators, top engineering peers, IEEE leadership, and tech mentors.
- **Learn & Grow:** Level up engineering craft through hands-on workshops, system design feedback, and cutting-edge framework exposure.

## Entity & Geographic Identification

- **Host Institution:** Nirma University (Institute of Technology)
- **Host Chapter:** IEEE Computer Society (SBC Nirma University)
- **City / Region:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (Western India tech corridor)
- **Country:** India (IN)
- **Languages Supported:** English (Primary), Hindi, Gujarati
